summary: Tested Phase 4 (signup OTP + duplicate reg block + admin account controls + disabled-partner referral attribution) on backend + frontend. Backend: 5/11 new pytest cases pass. The core account-status feature is UNIMPLEMENTED on backend — the PATCH /api/admin/customers/{uid}/status endpoint does not exist (returns 404), breaking Pause / Disable / Delete / Delete Permanently / Activate end-to-end. Frontend UI (AccountStatusControl + AdminCustomers + PasswordInput) is fully wired with correct data-testids and its client-side 'reason required' validation works — but every action's API call fails with 404. Signup OTP flow, duplicate-registration blocking, gmail-alias delivery, unverified-user hiding, and all 3 password toggles are working correctly.

critical.issue: Route is NOT DEFINED in /app/backend/server.py. Direct curl returns 404. Frontend AccountStatusControl.jsx line 33 calls it for every Pause/Disable/Delete/Purge/Activate action → all fail. There is also no purge (permanent delete) endpoint, no logic to set account_status/account_status_reason on the user doc, no cascade-purge of wallet/withdrawals for status='purge'. public_user() already exposes account_status + account_status_reason, so seeing them is fine, but nothing writes them.

minor.issue: When Emergent email provider returns 429 (Too Many Requests) on ~2-3rd retry, backend returns 502 to the client (from `if not sent` branch line ~383). Not a bug per se, but parallel/rapid signups will fail. Consider queuing or throttling, or return 200 with a 'delayed' state and re-request via /auth/resend-otp.

Duplicate-mobile check uses regex suffix match on stored mobile field — works, but a stored mobile like '99999999999' (11 digits from a broken older row) would false-positive against '9999999999'. Consider normalising all stored mobiles to 10 digits and using equality.

ui_bugs.issue: All Pause/Disable/Delete/Activate/Purge buttons render correctly with correct data-testids, and 'Please write a reason' toast fires client-side when reason is empty, BUT confirming with a reason bubbles up backend 404 'Not Found' from missing endpoint (see backend critical). No UI defect — pure backend gap.

integration_issues.issue: PATCH /api/admin/customers/{uid}/status returns 404; toast shows the backend 404 error. Cannot verify any customer status transitions end-to-end from UI until backend endpoint is implemented.

action_items: IMPLEMENT PATCH /api/admin/customers/{uid}/status in /app/backend/server.py (admin only). Body: {status, reason}. status ∈ {'active','deactivated','disabled','deleted','purge'}. Rules: (a) reason required for any status != 'active' → 400 'Please write a reason' if empty/whitespace, (b) 'purge' must db.users.delete_one + delete related transactions/withdrawals/notifications/leads.partner_id references, (c) other statuses set users.account_status + users.account_status_reason + users.account_status_updated_at, (d) return {message: '<status> applied'}.
Ensure /admin/customers already handles include_deleted=true (it does — line 1462-1465) and that deleted users are hidden by default (they are).
auth_utils.get_current_user_from_db already blocks deactivated/disabled with 403 and deleted with 401 → these will start working automatically once the write endpoint exists.
Verify /api/auth/login already respects account_status (it does — server.py 568-572) once the field is actually set by the new endpoint.
Referral attribution on /api/leads/{slug} for disabled/deleted partners already correctly returns partner=None (server.py 800) → no code change needed; retest once the disable action works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1707 lines — split into routers (auth, admin_users, admin_customers, leads, campaigns, wallet, security) urgently.
auth_utils.ACCOUNT_STATUS_MESSAGES is missing an entry for status='deleted' — token check returns 401 'User not found' which is fine, but keeping a symmetric map would be cleaner.

public_user() returns account_status_reason unconditionally — expose only to admins? Currently a customer's own /auth/me will leak the admin-set reason to the customer (e.g. 'suspected fraud'). Consider stripping account_status_reason from the customer's own view.
Frontend AccountStatusControl 'purge' uses window.confirm — fine for MVP but not accessible. Consider a typed-confirm modal like GitHub delete-repo.

AccountStatusControl.jsx line 48: available buttons for status=='disabled' or 'deactivated' include Delete but not the disabled option again — consider showing all 3 alternate options so admin can flip Pause → Disable without going via Activate.

server.py line 337 duplicate-mobile check regex `{mobile}$` is not anchored at start and doesn't `$options: i` — with the current 10-digit normaliser it's OK, but brittle if mobile normaliser ever changes.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: Backend endpoint PATCH /api/admin/customers/{uid}/status is not implemented in /app/backend/server.py despite the frontend AccountStatusControl.jsx (line 33) calling it. Grep confirms no route matches 'customers/{'. Reproduction: `curl -X PATCH https://.../api/admin/customers/xxx/status -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' -d '{...}'` → 404. Mitigation: Main agent must add the endpoint (see action_items #1). Once added, users' account_status will be respected by existing login (server.py:568-572) and by get_current_user_from_db (auth_utils.py:75-79) and by /admin/customers hide/show logic (server.py:1462-1465), and referral attribution for disabled/deleted partners is already correct at server.py:800.
